mapper.sql: id, usage_code, company_id, user_id, instance_id, task_id, model, model_type, token_input, token_output, token_total, unit_price_input, unit_price_output, cost, latency_ms, success, error_message, request_id, biz_date, create_by, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_agent_token_usage ( usage_code, company_id, user_id, instance_id, task_id, model, model_type, token_input, token_output, token_total, unit_price_input, unit_price_output, cost, latency_ms, success, error_message, request_id, biz_date, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{usageCode}, #{companyId}, #{userId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{model}, #{modelType}, #{tokenInput}, #{tokenOutput}, #{tokenTotal}, #{unitPriceInput}, #{unitPriceOutput}, #{cost}, #{latencyMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{requestId}, #{bizDate}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT biz_date, model, SUM(token_input) AS input_tokens, SUM(token_output) AS output_tokens, SUM(token_total) AS total_tokens, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM opc_agent_token_usage WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND biz_date >= #{startDate} AND biz_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY biz_date, model ORDER BY biz_date ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_calls, COALESCE(SUM(token_total), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS model_count FROM opc_agent_token_usage WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND biz_date = #{bizDate}
